review_protocol.reviewer: Codex manual content review; not blinded
review_protocol.useful_definition: Direct target evidence or explicitly qualified partial context; partial context does not establish outcome.
review_protocol.critical_gap_closure_definition: Previously missing decisive target-event evidence becomes available relative to the original parent packet, not merely an additional URL.
review_protocol.original_source_gap_definition: Previously unreadable original exact URL now has a readable repair; alternatives do not silently close that URL.

conclusion.discovery: More readable and topic-related additions, but no observed novel decisive evidence.
tradeoffs: Discovery consumes HTTP slots before original repair, losing two previously readable original-URL repairs.
Exact rule links can be institutional homepages or general policy context rather than event details.
Candidates include wrong years, post-deadline context, and incorrect legal/event phases.
conclusion.production_recommendation: Keep experimental; do not deploy discovery ranking as a demonstrated critical-gap improvement.
next_priorities: Reserve capacity for existing-byte and original-source repairs before exploratory alternatives.
Rank exact entity, event/metric, event date and page type above generic official-host overlap.
Deduplicate against existing packet coverage before fetching additional contextual pages.
